home.title: Sein Wut Hmon Group, Building Myanmar's Essential Industries
home.description: A diversified Myanmar conglomerate operating across marine resources, industrial supply, and nationwide distribution.

about.title: About, Sein Wut Hmon Group
about.description: Sein Wut Hmon Group, a Myanmar conglomerate building essential industries in fisheries, industrial supply, and nationwide distribution.

fisheries.title: Fisheries, Sein Wut Hmon Group
fisheries.description: One of Myanmar's most established commercial fishing fleets. Twenty vessels, ten million in assets, export-capable operations across a 2,832 km coastline.

distribution.title: Trading & Distribution, Sein Wut Hmon Group
distribution.description: Fourteen branches, one hundred forty-five vehicles, two hundred fifty employees. One of Myanmar's most comprehensive distribution networks, carrying international brands to every region of the country.

industrialInputs.title: Industrial Inputs, Sein Wut Hmon Group
industrialInputs.description: Fertilizer and lubricants for Myanmar, anchored by the MMF joint venture with Marubeni at Thilawa and the Nasa and Sunoco lubricant lines.

csr.title: Corporate Social Responsibility, Sein Wut Hmon Group
csr.description: How Sein Wut Hmon invests in the communities where it operates, through school support, disaster relief, and long term community development.
